messages:
Tara Wilson: quick heads-up: after enabling tenant-aware routing in canary we saw several requests for tenant `lynx-labs` with project attribution missing in quota logs around 14:03.
Jared Moss: saw that. looks like proxy now routes to tenant pool earlier and quota service is reading the routed identity instead of the original project claim.
Sofia Ruiz: PR note: we attach `x-tenant-pool` for batching. we didn't expect it to affect quota lookup.
June: mitigated by flipping per-tenant fallback for lynx-labs via the console at 14:06. ops-bot applied the flag.
ops-bot: feature flag applied routing.fallback.lynx-labs = ON (run id: ff-7203)
Tara Wilson: short term runbook step: if you see project=unknown for a tenant, enable fallback and alert billing.
Jared Moss: long-term fix: proxy should preserve original project claim in `x-original-project` and forward to quota service. quota should prefer that header when present. less invasive than reordering.
Sofia Ruiz: agree. i'll prototype header passthrough and add integration tests asserting quota uses x-original-project.
Tara Wilson: add telemetry: tag routing_decision in token logs and a dashboard card: "route decision vs quota project" filtered by tenant. product wants visibility for rollouts.
June: i'll add the dashboard card and a simple alert: page eng-platform if any tenant has >1% requests with project=unknown for >3m after a routing change.
Jared Moss: owners: Sofia -> header + tests, Tara -> telemetry + dashboards, June -> runbook + comms. timeline: staging prototype today, small canary tomorrow.
Tara Wilson: sounds good. i'll draft a quick note to Lynx Labs ops explaining temporary fallback and that we're rolling a fix.
Sofia Ruiz: PR will include unit tests and an integration test. tagging you all for review when ready.
June: closing loop once canary passes, thanks.
